name: ThemeForge
overview: Automatically finds, scores and assigns theme songs for movies and TV shows.
description: ThemeForge searches YouTube with yt-dlp, ranks every candidate with an explainable scoring engine, and writes the winner to theme.mp3 beside your media. High-confidence matches are assigned automatically; anything less certain waits in a review queue. Every theme is loudness-normalised at encode time so themes play at a consistent volume, which Jellyfin itself provides no way to control. All decisions are recorded in a persistent index, so re-runs are idempotent and manual choices are never overwritten.

versions.changelog: First release. Automatic discovery and scoring, loudness-normalised themes, review queue, a persistent decision index, a dedicated log file, and full cleanup on uninstall.
